children.name: Thamnasteria mettensis
children.description: Massive thamnasterioid corallum without epitheca (14 to 38 mm in size). Radial elements are subcompact (upward) to compact (in depth), septa or biseptal sheets sometimes anastomosed and often sinuous. Distal edge with regular small teeth, which diameter decrease from the periphery to the center of the calice. These teeth are often well detached at the distal-inner edge. False pennulae small, in the form of horizontally flattened dentate expansions never turned upward and not alternating or corresponding from a septum to the neighbouring one or from one side to the other of a single septum. Acute granules also present on lateral faces. Styliform columella in depth. Endotheca present, made of numerous dissepiments. Synapticulae abundant, wall absent. Calicular diameter: 3.5 to 6 mm – Distance between calices: 3.5 to 6 mm – Number of septa: 20 to 30 – Septal density: 6 to 7 for 2 mm.
